faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lede: Clear answers to common questions about custom employee ID card printing, customization, and bulk ordering.

faqs.q: What is an employee ID card?
faqs.a: An employee ID card is a personalized identification card issued by an organization to identify its employees and display relevant employee and organizational information.

faqs.q: What information can be printed on an employee ID card?
faqs.a: Common information includes the employee's photograph, name, employee ID, designation, department, company name and logo. QR codes, barcodes and other information can also be included where required.

faqs.q: Can employee ID cards be customized?
faqs.a: Yes. The card design, information fields and organization branding can be customized according to the company's requirements.

faqs.q: Can you print employee ID cards in bulk?
faqs.a: Yes. IDGen supports bulk personalized ID card requirements for organizations.

faqs.q: Can I order employee ID cards with lanyards?
faqs.a: Yes. Employee cards can be combined with suitable holders, hooks and custom printed lanyards according to the required setup.

faqs.q: Can employee ID cards include QR codes or barcodes?
faqs.a: Yes. QR codes and barcodes can be included where required and where the supplied information supports their generation.

faqs.q: Can employee ID cards use RFID?
faqs.a: Yes. RFID cards are available for suitable identification requirements. The RFID technology should be selected according to the organization's compatible system.

faqs.q: Can employees collect their information digitally?
faqs.a: For suitable projects, IDGen Studio can support digital information and photograph collection and card preview.

faqs.q: How much does an employee ID card cost?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the card specification, quantity and personalization requirements. Current pricing is maintained on the central IDGen pricing page.
